Original Article Title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet
Summary: Security researchers from Eye Security executed an operation to remotely disable a vulnerable background updater associated with the abandoned Popcorn Time application. By registering a domain previously used by the updater, the firm pushed updates to millions of infected machines to prevent potential botnet exploitation.
Source Title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet

Original Article Title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet
Summary: Eye Research identified a critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-30612, in the Popcorn Time download client that allowed for unauthorized code execution via an abandoned update mechanism. To prevent the creation of a massive botnet, the researchers actively disabled the vulnerable updater on affected systems.
Source Title: Operation IXIM: Preventing a botnet of millions of Popcorn Time users - Eye Research
